svg.title: My ninja way
svg.desc: Maddy stands with arms crossed beside three things he builds: web apps, mobile apps and AI tools.

g.text: Full-stack developer turned entrepreneur, building products end to end.
MERN and Next.js builds: dashboards, SaaS and marketing sites
Kotlin for Android, Swift / SwiftUI for iOS, Flutter for both
AI tools that do real work
Agents, automations and data tools in Python and TypeScript
“Build it. Ship it. Then build the next one.”
